# Construct test output: 13x13 with four 5x5 panels, one-cell separators and border.
N=13
out=[[9]*N for _ in range(N)]
panels=[(1,1,7,[[1,1,0],[1,1,0],[0,0,1]]),
        (1,7,5,[[1,0,1],[1,1,1],[0,1,0]]),
        (7,1,3,[[1,1,1],[0,1,0],[0,1,0]]),
        (7,7,2,[[1,0,1],[1,1,0],[0,1,0]])]
for r0,c0,col,mask in panels:
    for r in range(5):
        for c in range(5): out[r0+r][c0+c]=col
    for r in range(3):
        for c in range(3):
            if mask[r][c]: out[r0+1+r][c0+1+c]=9
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in out))
